systems.name: Lost Age Stack
systems.canon_rule: Separate archaeology, classical tradition, and contested impact research; do not make Gobekli Tepe alien-built.

systems.name: Technology-Shaped Sky
systems.lineage: Mystery airships / foo fighters / ghost rockets
systems.canon_rule: Witness interpretation changes with the newest available technology.

systems.name: Premodern Contact Forms
systems.canon_rule: Forbidden knowledge and communication-failure motifs predate modern ET language.

systems.name: Engineering Scripture
systems.canon_rule: Modern engineering reinterpretation of scripture, not a historical technical manual.

systems.name: Vimana Mutation
systems.canon_rule: Separate old literary motifs from the modern text and modern aerospace claims.

systems.name: Planet X Convergence
systems.lineage: Lowell Planet X / Nemesis / Tyche / Nibiru / Planet Nine
systems.canon_rule: Distinct astronomical and conspiracy lineages are often collapsed into one hidden planet story.

systems.name: Real Weird Space Programs
systems.lineage: Horizon / lunar research / West Ford / Starfish Prime
systems.canon_rule: Real extreme Cold War studies and experiments explain why later secret-space stories feel plausible.

systems.name: False-Flag Mutation
systems.canon_rule: A real proposal is evidence of proposal, not execution or alien involvement.

systems.name: Rescue Prophecy
systems.canon_rule: Useful for evacuation and consent ethics; treat tragic movements respectfully.

systems.name: Automatic-Writing Cosmic Bureaucracy
systems.canon_rule: Elaborate cosmic bureaucracy predates the flying-saucer age.

systems.name: Human Technological Surprise
systems.canon_rule: Strong Human explanations must be tested before ancient-alien attribution.

systems.name: Planetarium / Censored Sky
systems.canon_rule: Artificial observation manipulation is a theoretical possibility, not evidence our sky is fake.

systems.name: Aestivation
systems.canon_rule: Long-term computation motives can make active civilizations appear absent.

systems.name: Expansion Fronts
systems.canon_rule: Expansion can be modeled as spatial fronts; canon maps this to five different conquest verbs.

systems.name: METI / Arecibo
systems.lineage: Deliberate Human signaling and dark-forest anxiety
systems.canon_rule: Humanity has intentionally transmitted; no established alien response follows.

systems.name: Disclosure Feedback Loop
systems.canon_rule: Claims, policy terminology, archives, and media can reinforce one another without independently proving the claim.

systems.name: Sensor Threshold Cascade
systems.canon_rule: Changing sensor settings changes what becomes visible and therefore what counts as anomalous.
